title: 01A · The architectural opening
note: Arrival holds. The architecture changes depth around a fixed reading rail; the central aperture becomes the laptop stage. Mobile places one simplified aperture below the CTA.

title: 01B · A stage for the existing laptop
note: The protected laptop remains the focal object. Surrounding rails settle at its opening, zoom and inspection stages. The pictured laptop is an unaltered screenshot crop of the existing model, not a replacement asset. Mobile uses the existing browser fallback.

title: 02A · One object, three transformations
note: One set of interface planes aligns, connects into structural rails, then resolves into a completed interface. Labels and short descriptions stay settled; they are not attached to moving planes. The terminal rail becomes the service dividers.

title: 02B · Warm ivory, editorial services
note: Navy passes through warm stone into ivory while the same guide line remains. Text appears only on the settled surface. Three service rows retain every description and feature; there is no flying-card carousel or extra pin.

title: 03A · The website becomes the object
note: Actual existing project imagery, uncropped and undistorted. A shallow entry tilt settles near front-on for inspection. Copy, concept disclosure, progress, arrows and case-study links remain accessible. These are two states of one showcase, not two new sections.

title: 03B · The website becomes the object
note: Actual existing project imagery, uncropped and undistorted. A shallow entry tilt settles near front-on for inspection. Copy, concept disclosure, progress, arrows and case-study links remain accessible. These are two states of one showcase, not two new sections.

title: 04 · An editorial studio, not another card grid
note: The project ground line carries into a navy reading environment. Copy stays in normal flow. A shared gold axis connects the three values; only its marker and ambient light respond to scroll.

title: 05 · A connected path with stable descriptions
note: Four steps share one continuous route instead of four animated containers. A marker advances along it; every description is available without waiting for its turn. On mobile the same route becomes a vertical spine. No pin.

title: 06 · A deliberate pause for reading
note: Warm ivory removes spectacle from decision-making content. Fine rules connect principles and FAQ; text remains still. The accordion keeps keyboard activation and expanded-state semantics. All answers remain in the source and accessible on expansion.

title: 07 · The aperture returns, the CTA stays ready
note: The opening architecture resolves into one quiet frame behind a stable final invitation. Email and project CTA are usable immediately; convergence never gates contact. Footer belongs to the same composition rather than another isolated card.
